meta.name: rules
meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询和配置 Codex Rules 的行为与规则文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要了解或调整 Codex 的规则行为
copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 装上后，被问及 Codex Rules 时，Claude 会说明：插件启用后，在会话开始和用户提交时自动注入静态项目指令，在 apply_patch 后注入匹配的文件规则；动态输出作为额外上下文注入并去重，不重写工具输出。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex Rules 的行为、规则文件位置、环境配置等时触发。

say.text: Codex Rules 支持哪些规则文件位置？
say.note: Claude 会列出 CONTEXT.md 等支持的来源。

say.text: 怎么用环境变量控制 Codex Rules？
say.note: Claude 会说明 CODEX_RULES_* 等配置项。

say.text: 旧版 PI_RULES_* 变量还能用吗？
say.note: Claude 会说明它们作为回退仍被接受。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when asked about Codex Rules, Claude explains: with plugin enabled, static project instructions injected at SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit; matching file rules after apply_patch; dynamic output added as extra context, deduplicated; tool output not rewritten.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, supported rule file locations, environment configuration, etc.

say_en.text: Which rule file locations does Codex Rules support?
say_en.note: Claude will list supported sources like CONTEXT.md.

say_en.text: How can I control Codex Rules with environment variables?
Are legacy PI_RULES_* variables still accepted?
say_en.note: Claude will say they work as fallbacks.
